title: Roasted Zesty Chicken Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian-inspired dish made with roasted chicken, zesty spices, and a hint of tagine.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together ghee or oil, salt, and tagine spice mix.
Add the chicken breasts and mix well to coat.
Transfer the chicken to a baking sheet and roast for 25-30 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, heat a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped ugli fruit and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5-7 minutes, or until caramelized.
Stir in the roasted almonds and zesty lemon juice.
To serve, slice the roasted chicken and serve with the ugli fruit and almond mixture spooned over the top.
